subject.title: Feishu (and non-Discord channels) should apply sanitizeAssistantVisibleText() on outbound text

question: Should this umbrella be resolved by landing narrow per-channel `sanitizeText` hooks for remaining channels, or by moving `sanitizeAssistantVisibleText()` into a shared outbound default?
rationale: Current main still has a Feishu gap and several open channel-slice PRs; changing the shared default affects all channel plugins, while per-channel hooks leave the umbrella open until every supported channel is audited.

options.title: Land narrow channel hooks
options.body: Review and land viable channel-slice PRs such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98705, keeping shared-default work as a separate follow-up if needed.

options.title: Move to shared default
options.body: Make assistant-visible sanitization the shared outbound default, but require focused compatibility tests for channels and plugin adapters that may legitimately send literal scaffolding text.

options.title: Split remaining work
options.body: Keep the Feishu PR as the Feishu fix and open or retain narrower channel issues for Mattermost, MS Teams, and any remaining uncovered adapters.

recommendation.title: Land narrow channel hooks
recommendation.body: Review and land viable channel-slice PRs such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98705, keeping shared-default work as a separate follow-up if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the shared sanitizer and outbound/channel boundary where steipete has the strongest history signal.
